source_access_note: Records without public links are not treated as missing. The tool distinguishes EMA request pathways, IMA Library request pathways, reference-only records and public online access.
knowledge_base_maintenance: The master list is generated from the canonical data/*.json source files. v8.1 retains the established v7.3/v6.12 interface while improving findability, shared search behaviour, mobile filters and cross-page state.
preview_note: Spatial Discovery keeps knowledge records, news coverage and AAQMN as independent display toggles. Live IMA REST/spatial layers are not part of this release.
news_note: EMA in the News contains 701 story parents linked to 785 selectable article records. Dynamic charts operate on the cleaned story/article model and include readable fallback tables.
international_scope_note: International references remain restricted to records materially related to Trinidad and Tobago.
video_note: Official EMA YouTube metadata remains an optional maintained record family.
deduplication_note: Story/article and document records remain distinct where they represent different source objects; duplicate IDs are prohibited.
use_note: This is an information-discovery prototype. Source descriptions, classifications, charts, maps and related-record suggestions are discovery aids, not legal or regulatory determinations.
